instruction: A candid medium shot of a residential outdoor scene during the day. On the right side of the frame, the woman in the black patterned blouse (R1) stands facing left, smiling. On the left, the man in the dark gray puffer jacket (R2) stands in profile, smiling and laughing happily. The man and the woman shake hands next to white pillars and a dark front door of the house. Natural daylight softly illuminates the scene, creating gentle shadows and a bright atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
